examples.en: Tony watched an exciting live basketball game last night.
examples.zh: Tony 昨晚看了一場刺激的現場籃球賽。

examples.en: Traveling to a foreign country is always an exciting experience.
examples.zh: 到外國旅行總是一段令人興奮的經驗。

examples.en: The exciting news about the new product launch spread quickly across the company.
examples.zh: 關於新產品發布的振奮消息迅速在公司內傳開。

examples.en: The movie featured several exciting action sequences that kept viewers on the edge of their seats.
examples.zh: 這部電影包含了幾個扣人心弦的刺激動作片段，讓觀眾坐立難安。

examples.en: Pioneering technological breakthroughs offer exciting opportunities for sustainable market growth.
examples.zh: 開創性的技術突破為永續的市場成長帶來了令人振奮的機會。

examples.en: Mr. and Mrs. Clinton are proud of their daughter because she is honest.
examples.zh: Clinton 夫婦以他們的女兒為榮，因為她很誠實。

examples.en: She felt proud when she received her graduation certificate.
examples.zh: 當她接過畢業證書時，她感到十分自豪。

examples.en: The entire team felt proud of completing the challenging project ahead of the deadline.
examples.zh: 整個團隊為能提前在截止日前完成這項艱鉅專案而感到驕傲。

examples.en: He was too proud to admit his mistakes and ask his colleagues for guidance.
examples.zh: 他自尊心太強，不願承認自己的錯誤並向同事請教。

examples.en: Organizations maintain a proud heritage of corporate responsibility and ethical innovation.
examples.zh: 這些組織保持著引以為傲的企業責任與合規創新的優良傳統。

examples.en: Henry always faces challenges in a brave way.
examples.zh: Henry 總是勇敢地面對挑戰。

examples.en: Learning a new language is a difficult challenge for many students.
examples.zh: 學習一門新語言對許多學生來說是一項艱難的挑戰。

examples.en: The economic downturn posed a serious financial challenge to the small enterprise.
examples.zh: 經濟不景氣對這家小企業構成了嚴峻的財務挑戰。

examples.en: Overcoming this environmental challenge requires close cooperation among nations.
examples.zh: 克服這項環境挑戰需要各國之間的緊密合作。

examples.en: Navigating complex regulatory frameworks presents an intricate operational challenge for modern corporations.
examples.zh: 遵循複雜的法規架構對現代企業構成了錯綜複雜的營運挑戰。

examples.en: Tom is nervous about the final exam.
examples.zh: Tom 對期末考很緊張。

examples.en: I always feel nervous before speaking in front of a large crowd.
examples.zh: 在一大群人面前發言之前，我總是感到緊張。

examples.en: She took a deep breath to calm her nervous energy before the interview.
examples.zh: 面試前她深呼吸以平復緊張的情緒。

examples.en: The nervous investor monitored the fluctuating stock index with growing anxiety.
examples.zh: 緊張的投資者帶著日益增長的焦慮密切關注著波動的股票指數。

examples.en: Heightened market volatility created nervous anticipation among institutional financial stakeholders.
examples.zh: 加劇的市場波動在機構金融利害關係人中引發了緊繃的觀望情緒。

examples.en: Asian elephants are different from African elephants.
examples.zh: 亞洲象和非洲象不一樣。

examples.en: My taste in music is quite different from yours.
examples.zh: 我對音樂的品味和你的相當不同。

examples.en: The two brothers look similar, but their personalities are completely different.
examples.zh: 這兩兄弟長得很像，但個性完全不同。

examples.en: Working in a startup is a completely different experience from working in a large corporation.
examples.zh: 在新創公司工作與在大企業工作是完全不同的體驗。

examples.en: Cultural expectations can be vastly different depending on the country you visit.
examples.zh: 根據你訪問的國家，文化期待可能會大相逕庭。

examples.en: The magic show was awesome. I enjoyed it a lot.
examples.zh: 那場魔術表演很棒。我很喜歡。

examples.en: We had an awesome time at the concert last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚在演唱會上玩得很開心。

examples.en: That is an awesome idea for our upcoming school project.
examples.zh: 這對我們即將到來的學校專案來說是個很棒的主意。

examples.en: The view from the top of the mountain was simply awesome.
examples.zh: 山頂上的景色簡直美得令人讚嘆。

examples.en: She possesses an awesome capability to solve complex technical problems under pressure.
examples.zh: 她具備在壓力下解決複雜技術問題的驚人能力。

examples.en: The fans were surprised at the famous singer's sudden marriage.
examples.zh: 歌迷們對這位名歌手的突然結婚感到很驚訝。

examples.en: I was surprised by the sudden change in the weather.
examples.zh: 我對天氣的突然變化感到驚訝。

examples.en: Everyone was surprised when he announced his resignation.
examples.zh: 當他宣佈辭職時，每個人都感到很驚訝。

examples.en: She looked surprised to see her old friend at the airport.
examples.zh: 看到老朋友在機場出現，她看起來很驚訝。

examples.en: The board of directors was pleasantly surprised by the company's quarterly growth.
examples.zh: 董事會對公司季度的成長感到喜出望外。

examples.en: Steve is interested in playing the guitar.
examples.zh: Steve 對彈吉他有興趣。

examples.en: Are you interested in joining our club?
examples.zh: 你有興趣加入我們的社團嗎？

examples.en: Many students showed a deep interest in the science exhibition.
examples.zh: 許多學生對科學展覽表現出濃厚的興趣。

examples.en: She became interested in photography after traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 她出國旅行後開始對攝影產生興趣。

examples.en: Investors remain intensely interested in renewable energy technologies.
examples.zh: 投資者對再生能源技術始終保持高度興趣。

examples.en: Before Judy makes a decision, she talks about it with her parents.
examples.zh: Judy 在做決定前，她和父母討論。

examples.en: It was a difficult decision to make.
examples.zh: 這是一個艱難的決定。

examples.en: The committee reached a final decision after hours of debate.
examples.zh: 委員會經過數小時的辯論後達成了最終決定。

examples.en: You need to take responsibility for your own career decisions.
examples.zh: 你需要為你自己的職涯決定負責。

examples.en: Strategic executive decisions shape the long-term trajectory of the enterprise.
examples.zh: 策略性的高層決策塑造了企業的長期發展軌跡。

examples.en: Hanna's cat died a few days ago, so she was quite upset.
examples.zh: Hanna 的貓幾天前死掉了，所以她十分難過。

examples.en: Don't be upset about making mistakes; you can learn from them.
examples.zh: 不要為犯錯感到難過；你可以從中學習。

examples.en: He felt upset when his proposal was rejected by the supervisor.
examples.zh: 當他的提案被主管拒絕時，他感到很沮喪。

examples.en: She was deeply upset by the unfair comments made online.
examples.zh: 她對網路上不公平的評論感到非常難過。

examples.en: Employees became visibly upset upon hearing news of the restructuring.
examples.zh: 員工在聽到重組的消息後顯得相當沮喪。

examples.en: We can't trust Ben because he likes to tell lies.
examples.zh: 我們不能信任 Ben，因為他喜歡說謊。

examples.en: Trust me, everything is going to be fine.
examples.zh: 相信我，一切都會好起來的。

examples.en: Building mutual trust is essential for a successful partnership.
examples.zh: 建立互信是成功合作夥伴關係的根本。

examples.en: She earned the trust of her team members through consistent hard work.
examples.zh: 她透過持續的努力贏得了團隊成員的信任。

examples.en: Consumer trust remains the cornerstone of any sustainable commercial enterprise.
examples.zh: 消費者信任始終是任何永續商業企業的基石。

examples.en: I can't believe it! I just took a picture with my favorite actor.
examples.zh: 我真不敢相信！我剛剛跟我最喜歡的演員拍了一張照片。

examples.en: Do you believe in ghosts?
examples.zh: 你相信有鬼嗎？

examples.en: I believe that hard work eventually pays off.
examples.zh: 我相信努力終究會有回報。

examples.en: Few people believed his extraordinary story at first.
examples.zh: 起初很少有人相信他那離奇的故事。

examples.en: We firmly believe in fostering an inclusive and innovative work environment.
examples.zh: 我們堅信培育一個包容且創新的工作環境。

examples.en: The weather today is perfect. Let's go to the beach!
examples.zh: 今天的天氣很好。我們去海灘吧！

examples.en: Practice makes perfect.
examples.zh: 熟能生巧。

examples.en: The timing for the product launch was simply perfect.
examples.zh: 產品發布的時機簡直完美。

examples.en: She found the perfect apartment close to her workplace.
examples.zh: 她找到了靠近工作地點的完美公寓。

examples.en: Achieving absolute perfection in complex systems requires meticulous engineering.
examples.zh: 在複雜系統中實現絕對完美需要一絲不苟的工程設計。

examples.en: Joe studies very hard, so he will certainly pass the exam.
examples.zh: Joe 很用功，所以他一定會通過考試。

examples.en: I will certainly help you with your project.
examples.zh: 我一定會幫你處理你的專案。

examples.en: This new policy will certainly improve employee satisfaction.
examples.zh: 這項新政策勢必會提升員工滿意度。

examples.en: You can certainly rely on her expertise in this matter.
examples.zh: 在這一點上，你絕對可以信賴她的專業知識。

examples.en: Advanced automation will certainly redefine operational workflows across industries.
examples.zh: 先進的自動化勢必重新定義各產業的營運工作流程。

examples.en: My one-month trip to Italy on my own was unforgettable.
examples.zh: 我獨自義大利一個月的旅行令人難忘。

examples.en: We had an unforgettable evening celebrating our graduation.
examples.zh: 我們度過了一個慶祝畢業的難忘夜晚。

examples.en: Meeting my childhood hero was an unforgettable experience.
examples.zh: 見到我兒時的英雄是一段難忘的經歷。

examples.en: The breathtaking sunset over the ocean left an unforgettable impression.
examples.zh: 海面上壯麗的日落留下了難忘的印象。

examples.en: Her visionary leadership remains an unforgettable milestone in corporate history.
examples.zh: 她具前瞻性的領導力成為企業歷史上難忘的里程碑。

examples.en: Every time Anna looks at those photos, she thinks of the sweet memories of her high school life.
examples.zh: 每次 Anna 看那些照片，她就想起高中生活的甜蜜回憶。

examples.en: I have good memories of my childhood.
examples.zh: 我有很好的童年回憶。

examples.en: The old photograph brought back warm memories of the past.
examples.zh: 這張舊照片勾起了對過去溫馨的回憶。

examples.en: She has a sharp memory and can remember names easily.
examples.zh: 她記憶力敏銳，能輕易記住名字。

examples.en: Optimizing cache memory performance is vital for high-speed computing hardware.
examples.zh: 優化快取記憶體效能對高速運算硬體至關重要。

examples.en: The traffic is terrible, but since we are all in the same boat, we should not get angry.
examples.zh: 交通很糟，但既然我們處境都一樣，我們就不該生氣。

examples.en: Don't worry about the tough assignment; we are in the same boat.
examples.zh: 別擔心這項艱難的任務；我們處在同一條船上。

examples.en: Many small business owners found themselves in the same boat during the economic slowdown.
examples.zh: 在經濟放緩期間，許多小企業主發現自己身處同樣的困境。

examples.en: Instead of blaming each other, remember that we are all in the same boat and must cooperate.
examples.zh: 與其互相指責，不如記住我們同舟共濟，必須互相合作。

examples.en: Competing domestic manufacturers realized they were in the same boat when confronted with global supply chain disruptions.
examples.zh: 當面臨全球供應鏈中斷時，相互競爭的國內製造商意識到彼此休戚與共。

examples.en: A good teacher often makes a difference in her or his students' lives.
examples.zh: 一位好老師常為她或他的學生的生活帶來改變。

examples.en: Even small donations can make a difference to families in need.
examples.zh: 即使是小額捐款也能為有需要的家庭帶來改變。

examples.en: Volunteering on weekends is a meaningful way to make a difference in your local community.
examples.zh: 週末當志工是在當地社區發揮影響力的有意義方式。

examples.en: Adopting energy-efficient habits can make a significant difference to monthly electricity costs.
examples.zh: 養成節能習慣可以對每月的電費開銷產生顯著的影響。

examples.en: Implementing targeted mentorship initiatives can make a substantial difference in corporate talent retention.
examples.zh: 落實具針對性的導師計畫能對企業人才留任產生實質影響。

examples.en: Every swimmer went for first prize in the swimming race.
examples.zh: 游泳比賽中每位游泳選手都努力爭取第一名。

examples.en: If you really want that scholarship, you should go for it.
examples.zh: 如果你真的很想拿到那筆獎學金，你應該全力爭取。

examples.en: She decided to go for the promotion after working diligently for three years.
examples.zh: 在辛勤工作了三年後，她決定積極爭取這次升遷。

examples.en: The soccer team went for the win in the final minutes of the championship match.
examples.zh: 足球隊在冠軍賽的最後幾分鐘奮力爭取勝利。

examples.en: Venture capitalists encourage founders to aggressively go for market leadership.
examples.zh: 創投家鼓勵創辦人積極爭取市場領導地位。

examples.en: Although the job is not easy, John never gives up.
examples.zh: 雖然這份工作不容易，但是 John 從不放棄。

examples.en: Never give up on your dreams, no matter how hard things get.
examples.zh: 無論事情變得多艱難，永遠不要放棄你的夢想。

examples.en: He had to give up playing basketball because of a serious knee injury.
examples.zh: 由於嚴重的膝蓋傷勢，他不得不放棄打籃球。

examples.en: She refused to give up until she found an effective solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 在找到解決問題的有效辦法之前，她拒絕放棄。

examples.en: Visionary leaders persistently pursue their strategic goals rather than giving up during economic downturns.
examples.zh: 具遠見的領導者會堅持不懈地追求其策略目標，而非在景氣低迷時輕言放棄。

examples.en: Nancy decided to study in France, and her parents had her back.
examples.zh: Nancy 決定在法國念書，而她父母支持她。

examples.en: True friends will always have your back when you face difficulties.
examples.zh: 當你面臨困難時，真正的朋友總會支持你。

examples.en: It is reassuring to know that your teammates have your back during critical tasks.
examples.zh: 在執行關鍵任務時，知道隊友支持你令人感到安心。

examples.en: The manager assured the employees that leadership would have their back throughout the transition.
examples.zh: 經理向員工保證，在整個過渡期內領導階層都會支持他們。

examples.en: Fostering an enterprise culture where colleagues genuinely have each other's back drives organizational resilience.
examples.zh: 培育同仁真誠相挺的企業文化能推動組織的韌性。

examples.en: Stacy asks questions all the time because she wants to know more about the world.
examples.zh: Stacy 總是問問題，因為她想更了解這個世界。

examples.en: He checks his smartphone all the time while waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 他在等公車時總是一直看智慧型手機。

examples.en: Weather patterns in this region seem to be changing all the time.
examples.zh: 這個地區的天氣型態似乎無時無刻都在變化。

examples.en: She practices her public speaking skills all the time to gain confidence.
examples.zh: 她總是練習公開演講技巧以建立自信。

examples.en: Dynamic market conditions require modern enterprises to re-evaluate their strategies all the time.
examples.zh: 動態的市場狀況要求現代企業無時無刻不在重新評估其策略。
